svg.text: Front view, to scale (rail 210 mm). Cables A and B enter at the top, LAN at the bottom. Field cables land on the top of X1, wires inside the box on the bottom.
Straight wires: solid or stranded with ferrules into terminals. Curved wires: Dupont leads onto the ESP32 header pins (solder later for the final build).
Header positions on the ESP32 are drawn approximately; the pin numbers are what counts. Check the terminal order printed on each RS-485 module.
meter bus A+ / B− from Box 2
+5 V / return to Finder coil in Box 2
EXT1 pin 1 / EXT1 pin 3 / EXT2 pin 10
